questions.question:
A company is deploying the Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app.  
  
The company needs to configure several push notifications for sellers who use the app.  
  
You need to create the push notifications.  
  
Which feature should you use?

options.text: Plug-in
Cloud flow
Classic Dataverse workflow

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app push notifications are created with the **Send push notification V2** action in Power Automate. This action is part of a cloud flow and supports selecting the Sales mobile app, recipients, notification message, and an optional target record.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create custom push notifications for the Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/sales-mobile/create-push-notification)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Sales Professional.  
  
A new enterprise sales owner team needs to be created. The sales manager will be responsible for adding and removing team members, with a developer available to help.  
  
You need to create the new team.  
  
Which two values must be configured? Each correct answer represents part of the solution. **(Choose two.)**  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Business unit name
Team channel name
Team administrator
Team description
Team name

questions.explanation:
A Dynamics 365 Sales Professional team requires a team name and a team administrator. The team administrator manages team membership, including adding and removing members. The business unit name defaults to the organization name; a description is optional, and a team channel is not a Dynamics 365 team-creation requirement.

**Learn more:** [Create or manage teams in Dynamics 365 Sales](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/manage-teams)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has customized Dynamics 365 Sales so that sales users can create account plans for existing accounts. The Account table has a one-to-many relationship with the Custom Account Plan table.  
  
To comply with privacy laws, the organization must delete inactive account records after two (2) years.  
  
Some account managers observed that deleting accounts also deletes their linked account plans. They want to retain those account plans for reference.  
  
You need to ensure that account plans are **not** deleted when their accounts are deleted.  
  
Which behavior should be configured for the delete action in the relationship between accounts and account plans?

options.text: Cascade All
Cascade Active
Remove Link
Restrict

questions.explanation:
For a one-to-many Dataverse relationship, Remove Link clears the referencing lookup value on related account plan records when the account is deleted, but preserves the account plan records themselves. Restrict would instead prevent deletion while related plans exist; Cascade All would delete the related plans.

**Learn more:** [Configure table relationship cascading behavior (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/configure-entity-relationship-cascading-behavior)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are using Dynamics 365 Sales for a pharmaceutical company. Hospitals are configured as accounts, and nurses are configured as contacts under each hospital name.  
  
A nurse works part time for HospitalA and HospitalB. You add the nurse as a contact for HospitalA, then realize that a contact can be added to only one hospital.  
  
You need to make sure that the nurse is associated with both hospitals in the system.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create business units for HospitalA and HospitalB. Open the contact record for the nurse and assign it to a user in HospitalB.
Create an access team that has the nurse as owner. Open the HospitalA account record and assign it to the new team account. Repeat this process for HospitalB.
Open the HospitalB record and assign the nurse to a task activity.
Open the contact record for the nurse and create a connection to HospitalB.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Sales permits only one account association for a contact, but connections can associate a contact with additional account records and can use connection roles to describe the relationship. Creating a connection from the nurse’s contact record to HospitalB preserves the contact’s existing HospitalA association while recording the additional HospitalB relationship.

**Learn more:** [Add a connection role to link rows to each other - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/add-connection-role) · [Manage your accounts and contacts - Dynamics 365 Sales](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/accounts-contacts)

## General overview

CRONUS International Ltd. produces commercial printing supplies. At present, CRONUS groups its products under three (3) main printer brands.

CRONUS engages in demand generation:

- The marketing team captures and qualifies leads, then routes qualified leads to the sales teams.
- The sales teams send their own follow-up communications to potential customers after a lead has been routed to them. Sales team members only have access to the Sales Hub app and are UNABLE to trigger Customer Insights - Journeys emails.

## Existing environment

CRONUS has implemented Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys.

The CRONUS website is built on WordPress.

A form created in Customer Insights - Journeys has been embedded on the website's "Contact Us" page.

- The form is configured to create Lead records when submitted.
- Submitting a "Contact Us" form starts the creation of a Lead, which is then reviewed by a marketing user. The Lead is either disqualified or routed to the correct team using a business process flow.

Currently, Customer Insights - Journeys is used to send weekly email newsletters to Contacts based on which of the three (3) printer brands the Contact's company has purchased most recently.

CRONUS uses the default settings provisioned with the Customer Insights - Journeys application. Other than domain authentication of the CRONUS web and email domain, no additional settings have been created.

## New situation

### Upcoming conference

CRONUS has an upcoming annual conference where they plan to launch a partnership with a fourth (4th) printer brand.

The chief marketing officer's (CMO's) priority is to optimize the demand generation processes related to the conference.

### The launch strategy

The CMO wants to achieve a strong return on investment (ROI) by attracting sponsors to the conference.

CRONUS will hire celebrity speakers for the conference to increase overall interest and to boost the brand launch event.

These speakers have already been registered and configured in Customer Insights - Journeys. They will be booked and managed by Allure Bays Corp, a third-party supplier. The supplier has been added to Entra via guest access and has Dynamics 365 licenses.

### Implementation of the strategy

#### Pre-conference awareness

A teaser page will be published one (1) month before the conference to generate a list of interested Leads. Leads will be nurtured with pre-conference content and receive a registration launch announcement by email.

If the Lead clicks the "Learn More" link in the registration launch email, the link will take them to an event-specific portal, where they can sign up for the conference as a whole, as well as various tracks and individual sessions, including the launch sessions.

Existing Contacts will also receive the registration launch email and be able to sign up for sessions.

#### Registration campaign stages

If a Lead or Contact registers for one of the product launch sessions, they should NO longer receive additional invitations to register for product launch sessions.

Any Leads and Contacts who do NOT click on the "Learn More" link should be sent an additional launch announcement email reminding them to register.

#### Registration routing

Anyone registering for a product launch session should be directed to the sales team.

- If the registrant has an existing account owner, the registrant should be routed to that account owner. The account owner will send them a "Contact Outreach" email using CRONUS branding.
- If the registrant does NOT have an existing account owner, they should be routed to the inside sales team. The inside sales team will send them a "Lead Outreach" email using conference branding.

#### Event management

The event will be held in CRONUS's own "Presentation Building" with several usable rooms.

The CMO indicated that the "Presentation Room" should be used for the product launch sessions, while the "Conference Room" can be used for other larger sessions.

The CMO has several expectations for the event:

1. Accessibility - All rooms must be designed for accessibility.
2. Engagement - Multiple formats are available for the rooms. Specifically for the product launch sessions, the "Theater" format must be used to optimize engagement.
3. Attribution - It is necessary to be able to report on the Sponsorship amount achieved, as well as "New Opportunities," and ultimately "Opportunities Closed as Won," resulting from attendees of the product launch sessions.
4. Interest - The ROI for the product launch sessions must be optimized. Given that the room can only accommodate 100 guests and the event can only cater to 200 guests, the CMO wants to personally review which Contacts to add from high-value accounts if the room is close to capacity.

## New requirements

### Customer Insights - Journeys requirements

The conference strategy requires the following in Customer Insights - Journeys:

- Create a new lead capture form for the pre-conference page, creating Leads on submission.
- Create registration components.
- Create conference event and session records, including the following where appropriate:
  - Sponsors
  - Speakers
  - Room layouts
- Ensure registered Leads and Contacts are removed from the registration launch journey when they have registered for a product launch session.
- Ensure Leads and Contacts are routed to the correct account owner or Inside sales team members.
- Ensure account owners and inside sales team members have the correctly branded email templates to use in their one-to-one communication to Leads.

### Other requirements

Since the launch is quickly approaching, the web team does NOT want to commit to developing new WordPress landing pages.

- The new landing pages must be standalone pages hosted by Customer Insights - Journeys.
- The default registration forms must be used.
- The event portal must be a Power Pages portal. The portal must include the conference hero image, the conference logo, and a gallery of sessions guests can sign up for.

Currently, most users of Customer Insights - Journeys have a standard "CRONUS Marketer" security role assigned. However, third-party suppliers are NOT allowed to have access to Contact data, so the IT team has created a new security role named "Event Configurator" that allows access to Event records but NOT to Contact data.

questions.explanation:
A business process flow instance has a computed Duration for the time it was active, and Finished is an inactive completion status. However, a flow triggered only for won opportunities does not calculate durations for opportunities closed as lost. Also, a process instance can be set to Finished only when it is at its final stage, so this does not generally handle opportunities closed before the business process flow is complete.

**Background information**

Terra Flora, Incorporated is a boutique pet hotel that has been operating for six (6) months. The hotel’s guests include both dogs and cats.

The founder created the Dynamics 365 Sales Professional environment to expand their network and pipeline. They began by using only out-of-the-box capabilities and only the Sales Professional app. Only one environment, production, is in use.

The pet hotel is becoming more popular, and bookings are increasing. The founder has now shifted focus to customizing the environment so they can capture the information needed to delight customers by tailoring the experience to their unique pets.

Terra Flora has recently hired a part-time carer for the resident pets. The carer has been assigned the Salesperson security role so they can record new leads and update customer information.

You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Experience consultant hired to help Terra Flora with customizations, issue resolution, and recommendations for the best designs to satisfy their requirements.

**Configurations**

**Overall configurations**

To better understand their four-legged customers, Terra Flora has created a custom Pet table. It is user-owned and has a 1-n relationship with the Contact table, which represents the pets’ primary owner.

The Pet table has been added to the Sales Professional app sitemap. The table has the following columns, each created without changing the advanced options.

questions.explanation:
A business process flow such as "Onboard new pet" is backed by its own table that stores the process instance and its active stage, and that table ships with system views ("Active Onboard new pet" and "All Onboard new pet") which surface the active stage. To make the active stage visible in a view you simply work with one of those business-process-flow views and add the identifying columns from the underlying Pet table so each row shows the pet alongside its current stage. lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Sales administrator. You configure a forecast template that uses the Forecast category as the basis for a sales-team layout.  
  
The sales manager wants the Lost column to use Total Detail Amount rather than its default value, because revenue is always driven by the items.  
  
You need to make this change.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new forecast, remove the Lost column, and add a new calculated column.
Edit the existing forecast, remove the Lost column, and add a new calculated column.
Create a new forecast and update the Amount column in the layout.

A Forecast category rollup column derives its value from the configured Amount field. Setting that field to Total Detail Amount makes the Lost rollup use the item-driven revenue value. questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Sales to provide quotes to its customers.  
  
Preferred customers must receive a separate flat-rate discount for specific products, based on their countries or regions.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: A discount list for Preferred Customers.
A sequence command step.
A product bundle for each country/region.
A price list for the currency of each country/region.

questions.explanation:
A discount list is the Dynamics 365 Sales product-catalog feature for offering product discounts. Its type can be set to Amount, which applies a fixed monetary discount, and its discount details define the applicable quantities and discount value. A separate discount list can therefore represent the preferred-customer discount for the relevant products and regional pricing context.\
\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are implementing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data as the company’s Customer Data Platform. You configure the data sources and begin the unification process.

options.text: Choose the table with the most complete and reliable profile data about your customers.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company deploys Dynamics 365 Sales.  
  
The company has these requirements:  
  
- Employees must have quarterly goals. Each goal must calculate all deals won in that quarter.  
- Managers must be able to view the goals and calculations at any time.  
  
The solution must use goal features **WITHOUT customization**.  
  
You need to create the calculation.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Drill-down table
Rollup table
Rollup query
Goal metric

questions.explanation:
A goal metric defines how a Dynamics 365 Sales goal is measured. It can be configured as a count of Opportunity records with a Won status, using the Actual Close Date to determine the quarterly goal period. Goals then roll up the calculated actuals for managers to review. A rollup query is only needed to apply additional criteria to an existing goal metric.

**Learn more:** [Define a goal metric](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/create-edit-goal-metric) · [Define goal metric and rollup fields](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/developer/define-goal-metric-rollup-fields)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization's remote sales workforce has been using integrated Teams chat for internal collaboration. To save time, you tell the sales leader that suggested contacts can appear when a seller begins a new connected chat.  
  
The sales leader asks you to configure the capability to use suggested contacts.  
  
Which three users can be used as a rule for suggesting contacts? Each correct answer provides a complete solution. (Choose three.)

You need to configure the base unit group.  
  
Which quantity or measurement should you set up?

options.text: the least frequently used to sell the service
the lowest needed to sell the product or service
the most frequently used to sell the service
the highest needed to sell the product or service

questions.explanation:
A unit group’s primary unit establishes the lowest common unit of measure in which a product or service is sold. Other units in the group are defined as quantities of that base unit.\

questions.domain: Configure and customize Dataverse and model-driven apps
questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Sales administrator configuring a product catalog.  
  
You need to configure the base unit group.  
  
Which quantity or measurement should you set up?

options.text: primary unit
related unit
base unit

questions.explanation:
When you create a unit group in Dynamics 365 you fill in a Name and a Primary Unit, which is the lowest common unit of measure the product is sold in (for the battery maker, the individual battery). You must create this primary unit first, and only afterward do you add the additional units (box of 12, case of 24 boxes), each of which references a Base Unit. So the base unit is selected only when adding subsequent units, not created first, and "related unit" is not a Dataverse concept for this step. Therefore the correct first thing to create is the primary unit.

**Learn more:** [Create a unit group and add units](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/create-unit-group-add-units-that-group)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization uses Dynamics 365 Sales to monitor its sales pipeline and has implemented sales forecasting with the out-of-the-box sample forecast configuration.  
  
The vice president of sales wants the forecast to classify lost deals by using the more detailed opportunity status-code reasons **Cancelled** and **Outsold**.  
  
You need to enable the detailed categorization requested by the vice president of sales.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each answer presents part of a solution. (Choose two.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add the detailed lost reasons to the opportunity forecast category option set.
Create a new cloud flow to map opportunity state code to forecast category.
Add the detailed lost reasons to the msdyn_forecastinstance status code option set.
Update the field mappings in the Opportunity Forecast Category Mapping Process workflow.

questions.explanation:
Out-of-the-box opportunity forecasting uses the Opportunity Forecast Category option set for forecast buckets, while the Opportunity Forecast Category Mapping Process workflow maps opportunity close status information to those categories. Adding Cancelled and Outsold as forecast categories and updating that workflow’s mappings enables separate lost-deal categorization. Microsoft documents that this workflow updates the forecast category when an opportunity is closed as Won or Lost and that its conditions should be verified for each forecast category.

**Learn more:** [Troubleshoot issues with forecasting - Dynamics 365 Sales](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/sales/troubleshoot-forecast-issues) · [Capture forecast category for opportunity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/capture-forecast-category-opportunity)

The salespeople want to know when their emails will synchronize.  
  
You need to explain the server-side synchronization frequency to the salespeople.

constant
equal intervals

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to create a trigger-based journey to send the “Getting started” emails requested by the global sales lead.

options.text: Dataverse record change trigger

questions.explanation:

In the weeks before the holiday season, the marketing department creates a new segment-based journey.  
  
The journey sends a marketing email to all wine enthusiasts who meet these requirements:  
  
1. They have a wine order recorded against their contact record.  
2. They reside in Europe.  
  
You need to ensure that wine enthusiasts added later also receive this email automatically.  
  
How should the segment be configured?

options.text: Create a segment and add a group through Behavioral data.
Create a segment using refresh rate: Automatic Refresh.
Create a segment and add contacts through an included members group.
Create a segment and set the refresh rate to Static Snapshot.

questions.explanation:
A segment with **Automatic Refresh** is reevaluated as data changes, so contacts newly meeting the wine-order and Europe criteria become members. Segment-based journeys can admit newly added members when the segment refreshes. A static snapshot captures membership only at a point in time, while manually included members do not dynamically identify all future qualifying contacts.

**Learn more:** [Create a segment-based journey - Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/real-time-marketing-segment-based-journey) · [Create a static snapshot of a segment - Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/real-time-marketing-static-snapshot)

options.text: The delegate user.
System (as it is promoted by server-side synchronization).
The owner of the linked contact that sent the email.
The primary mailbox owner.

questions.explanation:
For an email tracked from a delegated mailbox, Dynamics 365 populates the Owner column with the delegate user’s manager, who is the primary mailbox owner. The system account is used for CreatedBy because server-side synchronization promotes the email, but it is not the email owner. You are creating a price list in Dynamics 365 Sales. Every price must end in $.98.  
  
You need to choose the function that sets this pricing requirement.

questions.explanation:

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A large construction company uses Dynamics 365 Sales to manage its sales pipeline.  
  
All prospective jobs are entered in the system as opportunities. Based on the work type, some opportunities close more quickly, while others take longer because they depend on third-party vendors.  
  
The sales team does **NOT** currently use the "On hold" option because it does **NOT** provide sufficient detail.  
  
When managing open opportunities, the sales manager wants to identify whether opportunities are awaiting permits or need asbestos removal.  
  
You need to ensure that a salesperson can select only the "Pending Permits" or "Asbestos Removal" option while working on their opportunities to show that the deal is taking longer.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Edit the statuscode column: add
Edit the statecode column: rename the
Edit the statecode column: rename the
Edit the statuscode column: add

questions.explanation:
In Dataverse, `statecode` represents the broad record status, while `statuscode` represents the status reason associated with that state. Detailed delay reasons should therefore be configured as status reasons for the Open state. Adding Pending Permits and renaming the unused On hold reason to Asbestos Removal provides the required selectable reasons without changing the opportunity state model.

**Learn more:** [Table definitions in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/entity-metadata) · [Define custom state model transitions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/define-custom-state-model-transitions)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the Dynamics 365 Sales administrator for an electronics company.  
  
The sales team is struggling to locate different products within the same category—for example, every available version of a flat-screen TV.  
  
You need to make it easier for the sales team to navigate products by using a taxonomy.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Product families
Product unit groups
Related products
Product bundles

questions.explanation:
Product families group and classify similar products in a hierarchical product catalog, making categorized products easier for salespeople to find and navigate. Product unit groups define units of sale, related products support cross-sell or substitute suggestions, and bundles package multiple products for sale.

**Learn more:** [Create and manage product families, products, bundles, and product properties (Dynamics 365 Sales)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/developer/create-manage-product-families-products-bundles-product-properties) · [Product catalog tables (Dynamics 365 Sales)](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/sales/developer/product-catalog-entities)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft SharePoint document management in Dynamics 365 Sales to store contracts.  
  
The company wants only the contracts team, which has a custom security role, to be able to access the documents. You need to restrict privileges to secure the documents.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new security role in Dynamics 365 Sales.
Update the users list in the SharePoint site.
Update privileges in the Dynamics 365 Sales security role of the contract team.
Create a new group in the SharePoint site.

questions.explanation:
Contracts stored through SharePoint document management are secured by SharePoint site permissions. Users accessing SharePoint from Dynamics 365 Sales must have appropriate permissions on the SharePoint site collection, so the site's user membership should be limited to the contracts team.
